rows.why: The Unrealized PnL value leg and the source-unavailable leg are verified by executed probes, but two further legs named in the row are not satisfied: Live Exposure is still the manual estimate and is not labelled as such or replaced by exchange truth, and the card does not flag a stale source.

executed_checks.observed: rendered DOM (renderCards + helpers extracted verbatim from the register blob, executed in a fresh headless Chromium on the live audit payload): label 'Unrealized PnL' value '$0.66' class 'value lc-pos'; all 7 card labels rendered

executed_checks.check: that value equals the exchange truth at snapshot time (independent oracle)

executed_checks.check: source unavailable shows n/a / Unavailable rather than 0
executed_checks.observed: same certified renderer with available=false and unrealized_pnl=null: 'Unrealized PnL' = 'n/a', 'Portfolio Value' = 'Unavailable'

rendered card shows no age/as-of/stale marker (source-renderCards has no age logic); the fresh master snapshot is ~10 s old and a STALE on-disk app snapshot (account 0xcccc..., fetched 1792154922440, unrealized_pnl 0.0) would render identically

executed_checks.check: Live Exposure is exchange truth or is explicitly labelled as the manual estimate

not executed against an induced API error; no non-destructive route to force a served-API error was available at capture

rows.harness_note: The :8031 service is NOT running the register-commit build (its Real Account strip renders the labels OPEN POSITIONS P&L (UNREALISED) / LIVE EXPOSURE / PORTFOLIO VALUE (TESTNET), which occur 0 times in the register blob). Rendering the live page would therefore certify the wrong artifact; the probe renders the certified renderer instead.
